items.heading: A School Counselling Cell,
items.text: A School Counselling Cell, A school counselling cell, a private independent counselor, and an online session are three different ways to reach the same role, none is automatically the right one for everyone.

items.heading: The Job Is to Move
items.text: The Job Is to Move The Job Is to Move The job is to move you from a confusing set of options to one specific, actionable recommendation, not to hand you a personality label.

items.heading: The Role Is Delivered Through
items.text: The role is delivered through a few different channels, and they are not interchangeable in terms of time, cost, or how personal the conversation gets.

items.heading: No Honest Counselor Can Guarantee
items.text: No honest counselor can guarantee a rank, offer, or placement. A guarantee is a red flag, not reassurance.
